response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, demonstrated leadership in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, and deep technical versatility across cloud, data, and distributed systems — but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade GenAI solutions, vector databases, or RAG architectures, and his resume emphasizes breadth over depth in core GenAI requirements.
strengths: Proven experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling at re:cinq
Extensive full-stack engineering background with TypeScript, cloud (AWS), and scalable data systems
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and building developer tooling across roles
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years dedicated to GenAI or production-grade AI systems; experience is broad but not narrowly focused
Missing explicit mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM optimization techniques in key projects
Limited documentation of customer-facing technical leadership or enterprise AI deployment experience
